Name: Two Witchy Looks by b0rszcz for Fashion Sense
Author: b0rszcz
Description:
I'm currently learning how to make clothes for Fashion Sense and I hope someone will enjoy my first attempts, lol. 


[b]Compatibility:[/b]
- 1.6 update
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15730]FS - Rainmoon's Elf Ear[/url] 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732]Expressive Elf Ears FS and Overlay[/url]﻿﻿

[b]Requirements[/b]: 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]

[b]How to Install:
[/b]- Unzip the file
- Move the folder/folders into your StardewValley/mods folder.
- Use a hand mirror (purchasable at Pierre's)
- Done!
